PROJECT BRIEF

Project Background

01

This development is for an Argentina-based client currently retailing imported Gymshark leggings who intends to transition into own-brand production using the reference garment as the benchmark.

The objective is NOT to produce an exact 1:1 replica.

The development priority is to achieve a comparable silhouette, compression level, on-body feel, and perceived quality while maintaining a commercially viable construction for own-brand production.

Development Sample 01 should achieve approximately 80–85% visual and functional alignment with the reference garment.

VALIDATION PRIORITIES
  • Fit
  • Compression
  • Silhouette
  • Fabric Quality
  • Premium Handfeel
  • Knit Engineering

06
ENGINEERING LOGIC

Construction Engineering

Glute Enhancement Construction System

!CRITICAL

The shaping effect must be engineered through the knit structure.

The shaping effect must NOT be created through:

  • Scrunch seam
  • Gathered seams
  • Exaggerated pattern shaping
  • Excessive back rise

The visual shaping effect must be achieved through:

  • Knit Mapping
  • Engineered Knit
  • Targeted compression
  • Horizontal stretch distribution
  • Engineered knit zones
07
DEVELOPMENT NOTES

Development Notes

↳

Unlike other performance leggings, this style must not create glute enhancement by increasing the back rise.

Visual shaping must be achieved primarily through seamless knit engineering and the strategic placement of compression zones.

THIS CONSTRUCTION PRINCIPLE MUST BE MAINTAINED THROUGHOUT DEVELOPMENT.

09
DEVELOPMENT TARGET

Development Goal

An exact replica is not required.

Develop a garment informed by the Gymshark reference that delivers a comparable overall wearing experience through:

  • Silhouette
  • Compression Level
  • Perceived Quality
  • Handfeel
  • Stretch Recovery
  • Knit Engineering
  • Premium Finish
The product should exceed the average quality level currently available in the Argentine market.
